newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes unchanged at 14 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes unchanged at 14 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed unchanged at 14 ringgit ($5.56) a kg on Tuesday on the strength of an overnight surge in the London Metal Exchange's values, traders said.
"Buyers were encouraged by the higher LME while sellers wanted to take profits," said a trader. "I think the support level for now is 14 ringgit."
Both sides matched positions at the close for a turnover of 113 tonnes, compared to 116 on Tuesday.
The local price premium against London narrowed to $45 from $95. -- K. Baranee Krishnaan (603-275-6833) ($1=2.5160 rgt)
